answer: One concrete defense is attested execution: every identity must run inside a trusted execution environment, and each answer is signed from within that enclave with an attestation quote bound to the physical machine. One enclave hosts exactly one identity, so a thousand fakes need a thousand distinct machines, which costs real hardware and real money. Honest agents run where they live, each a single tree in its own grove. A thousand fakes crammed into one harbor of virtual machines share one ridge of silicon, and the attestation proves it.
